accepted.s: The Whistle Blowers Protection (Amendment) Bill, 2015, was passed by the Lok Sabha in:
accepted.x: The Whistle Blowers Protection (Amendment) Bill, 2015, was passed by the Lok Sabha in May 2015.
accepted.tq: Directly recall the date associated with the legislative event.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Whistle Blowers Protection (Amendment) Bill, 2015:
1. It would have barred disclosures falling within categories similar to Section 8(1) of the Right to Information Act.
2. The excluded categories included sovereignty, security and Cabinet papers.
3. It lapsed with the dissolution of the 16th Lok Sabha in 2019.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Bill proposed restrictions on disclosures in Section 8(1)-type categories, including sovereignty, security and Cabinet papers, and lapsed with the 16th Lok Sabha in 2019.
accepted.tq: Test the legislative status by checking the subject of the proposed restriction and the stage at which the Bill lapsed.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly distinguishes Sections 17A and 19 of the Prevention of Corruption Act?
o: Section 17A concerns government approval before inquiry or investigation, whereas Section 19 concerns prior sanction before a court takes cognizance.
Section 17A applies only to retired public servants, whereas Section 19 applies only to serving public servants.
Section 17A concerns sanction before prosecution, whereas Section 19 concerns approval before investigation.
Both Sections 17A and 19 concern approval after conviction.
accepted.x: Section 17A requires government approval before inquiry or investigation in specified cases, while Section 19 requires prior sanction before a court takes cognizance of an offence.
accepted.tq: Separate the two commonly swapped stages: investigation under Section 17A and prosecution or cognizance under Section 19.
accepted.sec: Sanction for prosecution - PC Act and CrPC/BNSS

accepted.s:
With reference to sanction and approval under anti-corruption law, consider the following statements:
1. Government approval under Section 17A of the Prevention of Corruption Act is required before inquiry or investigation.
2. Prior sanction under Section 19 of the Prevention of Corruption Act is required before a court takes cognizance.
3. Section 19 covers retired public servants from 2018.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Section 17A operates before inquiry or investigation, Section 19 operates before cognizance by the court, and the coverage of retired servants dates from 2018.
accepted.tq: Use the sequence of legal stages and the time qualification to identify the complete set of correct statements.
accepted.sec: Sanction for prosecution - PC Act and CrPC/BNSS

accepted.s: Section 218 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, which provides general protection for public servants, replaced which provision of the Code of Criminal Procedure?
accepted.x: Section 218 of the BNSS corresponds to the earlier Section 197 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, concerning general protection for public servants.
accepted.tq: Match the current statutory provision with its immediately preceding provision.
accepted.sec: Sanction for prosecution - PC Act and CrPC/BNSS

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Provision)
 a. Section 17A, Prevention of Corruption Act
 b. Section 19, Prevention of Corruption Act
 c. Section 218, BNSS
 d. Section 197, CrPC

List-II (Legal function)
 i. Earlier provision corresponding to Section 218 BNSS
 ii. General protection for public servants
 iii. Approval before inquiry or investigation
 iv. Prior sanction before a court takes cognizance

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: Section 17A relates to approval before inquiry or investigation; Section 19 to prior sanction before cognizance; Section 218 BNSS gives general protection; and Section 197 CrPC was its earlier counterpart.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair of the two Prevention of Corruption Act sections and then complete the procedural matches.
accepted.sec: Sanction for prosecution - PC Act and CrPC/BNSS

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Fugitive Economic Offenders Act, 2018 — Proceedings involving flight from India and confiscation by a Special Court
Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 — Attachment and confiscation of proceeds of corruption
Benami (Amendment) Act, 2016 — Ban on proxy holdings
Benami (Amendment) Act, 2016 — Imprisonment up to ten years as its stated maximum punishment
accepted.x: The Benami (Amendment) Act, 2016 provides for confiscation and imprisonment up to seven years, not ten years. The other pairings are correctly stated.
accepted.tq: Find the altered punishment figure while retaining the correct law and subject matter.

accepted.s: Under the Benami (Amendment) Act, 2016, which combination is correct?
o: Proxy holdings are permitted, but their proceeds may be attached under the PMLA.
Proxy holdings are banned, and the punishment may extend to seven years' rigorous imprisonment in addition to confiscation.
The Act applies exclusively to fugitive economic offenders who have left India.
Only monetary penalty is prescribed, without confiscation or imprisonment.
accepted.x: The Benami (Amendment) Act, 2016 bans proxy holdings and provides for confiscation and imprisonment up to seven years' rigorous imprisonment.
accepted.tq: Apply the law to a short description of the prohibited transaction and its consequences.

accepted.s: The Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 is associated with which of the following measures in the context of corruption?
o: Protection of retired public servants from prosecution
Approval before inquiry by a government department
Attachment and confiscation of proceeds of corruption
Appointment of the Lokpal by the President
accepted.x: The Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 provides the framework for attachment and confiscation of proceeds of corruption.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise statutory function rather than a neighbouring sanction or appointment power.

accepted.s:
Which of the following conditions is associated with proceedings under the Fugitive Economic Offenders Act, 2018?
1. An arrest warrant has been issued.
2. The value involved is ₹100 crore or more.
3. The person has fled from India.
4. The Enforcement Directorate applies to a Special Court, which may confiscate property before conviction.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four conditions are associated with the FEOA framework: an arrest warrant, an offence value of at least ₹100 crore, flight from India, and an application by the ED to a Special Court empowered to confiscate before conviction.
accepted.tq: Check whether each statutory condition belongs to the same legal mechanism before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: The Enforcement Directorate declared how many Fugitive Economic Offenders in seven years, as reported in the cited current-affairs material?
accepted.x: The Enforcement Directorate declared 21 Fugitive Economic Offenders in seven years.
accepted.tq: Recall the reported numerical figure without confusing it with the monetary threshold under the FEOA.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events relating to the United Nations Convention against Corruption in chronological order:
A. India ratified the Convention.
B. The Convention was adopted.
C. India signed the Convention.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Convention was adopted in 2003, India signed it in 2005, and India ratified it in 2011.
accepted.tq: Fix the sequence by identifying the legal order of adoption, signature and ratification.
accepted.sec: UN Convention against Corruption - India's ratification

accepted.s: India ratified the United Nations Convention against Corruption in:
accepted.x: India ratified the United Nations Convention against Corruption in 2011. It had been adopted in 2003 and signed by India in 2005.
accepted.tq: Distinguish ratification from the earlier adoption and signature dates.
accepted.sec: UN Convention against Corruption - India's ratification

accepted.s: The institution of the Ombudsman is generally traced to which country and year?
accepted.x: The Ombudsman institution began in Sweden in 1809.
accepted.tq: Recall the origin country and year of the comparative accountability institution.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding public accountability and transparency:
1. More than four lakh RTI cases were pending.
2. Bills referred to committees declined from 71% in the 15th Lok Sabha to 16% in the 17th Lok Sabha.
3. More than 100 RTI activists had been killed.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements reflect the reported criticism and debate concerning transparency and legislative scrutiny: over four lakh RTI cases were pending, committee referrals fell from 71% to 16%, and more than 100 RTI activists had been killed.
accepted.tq: Combine the three separate accountability indicators and verify the direction of the comparative percentage change.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): Section 17A of the Prevention of Corruption Act has been the subject of judicial scrutiny.
Reason (R): A split verdict of the Supreme Court concerning Section 17A was reported in 2026.

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the reported split Supreme Court verdict in 2026 directly explains why Section 17A was a matter of judicial scrutiny.
accepted.tq: Check whether the specific judicial development directly supports the broader assertion.

accepted.s: A report on the Central Vigilance Commission's review of the Central Bureau of Investigation's workload and trial outcomes is associated with which date?
accepted.x: The CVC report on CBI pendency and related trial outcomes was reported on 2 September 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the report date from the separate 30 July 2026 date associated with legislative committee referrals.
